exams.name: OPM USA Hire Assessments
exams.blurb: OPM’s online assessment platform delivering structured reasoning and job-simulation tests used across many federal agency hiring announcements.

exams.name: State Civil Service Examinations
exams.blurb: The collective merit-system examinations used by U.S. state governments to fill classified public-sector positions through open competition.

exams.name: U.S. Capitol Police Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A written and physical abilities exam for U.S. Capitol Police officers responsible for protecting Congress and Capitol grounds.

exams.name: U.S. Marshals Service Criminal Investigator Exam
exams.blurb: A selection exam and assessment for deputy U.S. marshal candidates covering judgment, reasoning and the demands of federal law enforcement.

exams.name: USCIS Immigration Services Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A USA Hire-based assessment for immigration services officers evaluating reasoning, writing and judgment for adjudicating immigration benefits.
